_comment: Painting -> Sketch (DomainNet). Fill in every empty path under 'paths' before running. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored by the scripts.

paths._comment: PUT THE REQUIRED PATHS HERE. All paths are absolute.
paths._source_dir: Labeled source (painting) images, one subfolder per class. Used by source_to_target.py.
paths._target_dir: Unlabeled target (sketch) images. Used by generate_tags.py and finetune_diffusion.py.
paths._tags_path: JSON file for the sketch attribute dictionary. Written by generate_tags.py, read by source_to_target.py.
paths._finetuned_model_save_dir: SAVE path: folder where finetune_diffusion.py saves the finetuned model (final LoRA weights plus checkpoint-N subfolders).
paths._finetuned_model_load_path: LOAD path: saved finetuned model that source_to_target.py loads for generation. Usually the same folder as finetuned_model_save_dir, or one of its checkpoint-N subfolders, or a weights file.
paths._output_dir: Folder where source_to_target.py saves the generated sketch images and prompts.json.

target_subset._comment: Fraction of the unlabeled target images used for tag extraction and LoRA finetuning. 0.01 = 1% (paper setting for DomainNet). The same seeded subset is used by both scripts.

sketch.llm_instructions: Describe it using monochrome sketch terminology and drawing style elements. Always emphasize black and white, grayscale or monochrome appearance, never a photograph, and do not mention any colors.
sketch.negative_prompt: vivid, chromatic, tinted, hued, pigmented, dyed, painted colors, painting, waterpaint, detailed, colorful

attributes.style: What artistic style is this sketch? Answer in 1-2 words (e.g., realistic, cartoon, abstract, technical, gestural).
attributes.medium: What medium or materials were used to create this sketch? Answer in 1-2 words (e.g., pencil, charcoal, pen, digital).
attributes.line_quality: What is the dominant line quality? Answer in 1-2 words (e.g., bold lines, fine lines, rough, smooth).
attributes.stroke_style: Describe the stroke style in 1-2 words (e.g., hatched, crosshatched, continuous, broken, gestural).
attributes.shading: What shading technique is used? Answer in 1-2 words (e.g., light shading, heavy shading, minimal, detailed).
attributes.composition: What type of composition is used? Answer in 1-2 words (e.g., centered, asymmetrical, balanced, dynamic).
attributes.perspective: What perspective technique is used? Answer in 1-2 words (e.g., linear perspective, bird's eye, close-up).
attributes.detail_level: Describe the level of detail in 1-2 words (e.g., minimal, detailed, rough, refined).
attributes.mood: What mood does this sketch convey? Answer in 1-2 words (e.g., peaceful, energetic, melancholic, joyful).
attributes.background: Describe the background in 1-2 words (e.g., landscape, plain, detailed, abstract).

finetune._comment: LoRA finetuning of the SDXL U-Net on the 1% target subset. Hyperparameters are placeholders: set them to the values used in the paper.

convert._comment: classes: null converts every class in source_dir; use a list such as ["syringe"] to restrict.
convert.negative_prompt: painting image, blurry, low quality, distorted, ugly, grainy
